description: This PHP class defines the AWS Lightsail client, which provides methods to interact with the Amazon Lightsail service. It uses PHPDoc annotations to document the available API methods, both synchronous and asynchronous, that correspond to various Lightsail operations.

classes.name: LightsailClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the Amazon Lightsail service, extending the generic AWS client and providing specific methods for various Lightsail operations.

methods.name: allocateStaticIp
methods.description: Allocates a static IP address for the Lightsail account.

methods.description: Attaches an SSL/TLS certificate to a distribution.

methods.name: attachDisk
methods.description: Attaches a disk to an instance.

methods.name: attachInstancesToLoadBalancer
methods.description: Attach instances to a load balancer.

methods.name: attachLoadBalancerTlsCertificate

methods.name: closeInstancePublicPorts
methods.description: Closes public ports on an instance.

methods.name: copySnapshot

methods.name: createBucketAccessKey
methods.description: Creates an access key for a bucket.
